dict.string: umbar lists your paired Bluetooth devices so you can connect headphones from the notch.
umbar shows your calendar events in the notch. Your events never leave your Mac.
umbar shows whether a Focus is on in the notch's quick toggles.
umbar lists your reminders next to your events in the notch. When you check a reminder off there, or uncheck it, umbar saves that change to Reminders. Your reminders never leave your Mac.
umbar reads the Wi-Fi name to label your network traffic totals. Your location is never used or stored.
